column1: # The boot stages of the YoRHa-OS boot screen (spec 011, data-model.md): systemd unit -> our line.
#   pattern  the raw unit name systemd sends (systemd-journald.service, dev-zram0.swap). At most one
#            "*": exact, prefix*, *suffix or prefix*suffix. The first pattern that matches wins.
#   label    the line, in English, at most 48 characters, ASCII only (the initramfs draws nothing
#            else). Never a technical name, never a text of the game. "-" = no line of its own: the
#            unit is only counted in its group.
#   group    services, volumes, devices, network or session (the generic line, "Starting system
#            services (12)"); "-" = not shown at all (targets, slices, sockets...).
# gen/embed-stages.py puts this table into yorha-os.script; run it after every change.
